calls.reason: The antecedent has not occurred: Anthropic's Oct 26 S-1 notice says the registration is not yet effective, and no completed IPO by either company is shown.
Reports confirm discounted May–June SpaceX compute rates and positive adjusted operating income in Q2. Nothing quantifies the discount or shows the profit depended on it.
Coverage describes a trailing four-week method that is sensitive to recent spending. No evidence shows OpenAI deliberately picking busy windows or timing disclosures.
Open-ended forecast with no deadline. The packet shows no revenue acceleration, only OpenAI's claimed 20% serving-cost cut, so the outcome cannot be judged.
CNBC reports OpenAI nearing a round of up to $30B led by UAE investors after investors approached it. It is not private-credit funding and has not closed, so it does not settle the forecast.
WSJ's ~$750B projection through 2030 is not a schedule of binding obligations, and the equity-for-compute aside is unverified. The evidence is mixed.
